name: Nairobi
summary: Nairobi is the tech heart of East Africa, nicknamed 'Silicon Savannah' for its startup ecosystem and pioneering role in fintech. Its altitude of almost 1,800 meters provides a temperate climate all year round, without the suffocating heat typical of other African capitals, and a very low cost of living compared to Europe. In exchange, the digital nomad must assume real counterparts: limited citizen security and notoriously dense traffic.
